horoscopes.horoscope: You will find work to be very stressful today. However, it will not prevent you from taking shots at your opponents. You are thoughtful, but can be cunning too. People would have gauged it by now. Ganesha advises you to go ahead nevertheless. Though personal matters are not highlighted for the day, a concern about emotional attachments with your spouse will keep bothering you. Your heart wishes for a chat with your sweetheart. You should go for it. You will fall in love and be loved. Ganesha feels that at the beginning of the day you may be working very hard and will be able to achieve all the targets. Mood will also remain very normal. You will be doing activities that will keep encouraging you. During first half of the day, trend of previous day will be operating. You will be more practical about money matters. Most of the aspects related to investments will be re-thought by you. Honest work always pays off, says Ganesha. You are advised to stick to a systematic approach towards work today. You may go for the hard work in the first half but later you will work harder to achieve your goal. The professional atmosphere will remain peaceful.

It is quite likely that grandparents will shower love at home and seniors will shower favours at work, says Ganesha. You will probably collect certain overdue payments in the afternoon. Later in the day, a gamble you took in business may pay rich dividends, expects Ganesha. Lucky Colour Deep Emerald Green Love will rule you throughout the day. Your sweetheart is likely to attract your attention today. End this lucky day with a candle light dinner. You are likely to make this day memorable. Ganesha feels a peaceful night is on the cards. Today you will be keeping good health. You may not face any major challenges on health front. There are chances of you focussing on development of work, for which you will have enough energy and focus both. It’s a good day from health angle. Ganesha feels that today you will be able to stay focused on business or work. There will be inclination towards increasing your business, or you will be able to contribute ably to your organization. You are in a mood to achieve the most important task today. This is a perfect day to discuss the problems hindering success. The solutions you come up with will prove beneficial. Your positive attitude towards life will inspire people at the workplace, feels Ganesha.

Today, resolving issues will be a tough task, but you will be able to accomplish it nonetheless. It may take time, but don’t lose hope. Persistence and hard work will be rewarding. The grind will increase your understanding of the things happening around you. You will be able to understand those around you better. You may also take your sweetheart on a shopping spree. As the professional life sounds hectic, you want to find solace in the arms of your loved one. You are likely to share some sweet words with your beloved. Thanks to the lucky placement of the stars. You may turn creative with the emotional support of your sweetheart. Ganesha foresees that today you shall be very focused at work. However, you may also be confused and lost in thought . Health front may draw your immediate attention. An ignored health issue from the past can trouble you a bit now. It is advisable to enroll in some health activities now. Starting the day on a low note, you shall get more and more pepped up as the day progresses, feels Ganesha. There will be a new paradigm shift towards the positive side as far as finances are concerned. The day will keep you busy with some activity or the other. It will be a stressful day and will leave you sick and tired. The major assignments, phone calls, responding to letters and emails will keep you engaged. Ensure that you don’t get into fights with anybody.

An enterprising day! You may have a chance of foreign travel, which could benefit you. Your health will not help you in your efforts. You will learn an important lesson of life in the afternoon. Your sense of intelligence will grow with the help of your sweetheart. You may feel good when your spouse fills your heart with joy and happiness. You are likely to learn a lot of positive things with your beloved. A romantic life is on the cards. You are likely to be in an okay mood but involvement in some creative activities can make u feel better. Your office life will be full of activities, but you’ll be able to meet all the deadlines. Health needs attention. Try to enroll in some sports now. Ganesha feels that today you shall realise that only your best well-wishers will help you when you need them the most, and that will make you understand exactly who are your best friends. This is an excellent time to learn from the people you meet. Luckily, you will be meeting or communicating with intelligent people from whom you will get a lot of information. The communication will prove to be beneficial to you in the long run.

You may want to carry some aspirin with you today, suggests Ganesha. For, there are strong indications that you shall be up against a lot of stress and tension at work. This headache-inducing factor aside, you have the uncanny knack of beating your opponents at their own game. This will superimpose your position of awe and respect at the workplace, as people realise the stuff you are made of. Go get em’ tiger!!. You are in a mood to maintain a sweet relationship but your beloved may want to stay detached. You need to understand his/her feelings. This is the time to sort out all the problems and arouse love. Being alone and emotional will not solve your problems. Ganesha foresees that on professional front this is a favorable day. People at work will get impressed by your work skills. Try to avoid stress as much as possible. Ganesha advises you to do things which make you happy as it’ll impact your health positively. Today is an auspicious day for you on the financial front, feels Ganesha, as someone is likely to propose a new venture in partnership with you. You are advised to agree to it as it will benefit you financially. You may have to keep a low profile as your stars are not supporting you. Your colleagues may oppose your stand and you have to go through some serious challenges. This is not the right time to force your will on others as you may invite a cold war.

Sorting out long-pending issues will be a lengthy process today. However, Ganesha advises you to be persistent as the results will make all your efforts worthwhile. You will gain the ability to look at things through other peoples’ eyes, so to speak. Be generous, as you may have to take your beloved out for shopping in the evening. Professional works will keep you busy. You will get hardly any time to spend with your loved one. Being in touch with your lover post lunch will keep a smooth relationship. If you are in a long-distant relationship, you will enjoy a great bond with your pen friend. This day may be less favorable from the health point of view. Ganesha advises you to be alert with health related issue. Enroll in some sports activities. Work like may keep you engaged the entire day. You can take break from work and relax for the day. In the latter part of the day, feels Ganesha, you may have to bear some unexpected expenses on account of ill-health, or some untoward accident. Be careful not to get trapped in debt. You are compelled to follow daily routines strictly at the workplace. Daily chores, attending calls in the office, replying to letters, meetings and seminars will keep you engaged. You may be very eager to share your ideas and you will get an opportunity to voice your opinion on certain issues.

Ganesha says you will get fame and prestige in the field of broad casting media and in the world of art. This is the evening where you will have to make a choice and decision regarding higher studies. Luck will be with you. Ganesha showers you with his blessing and grace. You have not planned for the day although you may share some interesting recipe for love with your better half. You are likely to take responsibilities for your partner. You may like to create the mood of love. Ganesha feels you tend to be romantic gradually. Being practical and skillful in professional front shall help you achieve targets at work. You may be little confused with your decisions but you’ll get a clear view of it latter. Health looks good and you may even enjoy some good leisure activities, says Ganehsa. Ganesha feels that you will not want to deal with day to day financial pressures or tensions today. After you are done with your routine work, you might give a thought to your financial condition. You will be driven by a desire to do something new. You may have always desired to take up some hobby but have not been able to do due to lack of time. This is a perfect day to get rid of boredom, says Ganesha.

Today will consist of varying highs and lows at work and in confrontations, predicts Ganesha. At work, you may end up quarrelling with your peers. You will be reasonable in your views and still you will find yourself on the receiving side of the argument. Evening will compensate for the tough day as you kick back and relax in the company of loved ones. You may remain temperamental today. Ganesha feels that you may not interact sweetly with your partner. If you are asked anything, you may tend to use harsh words. So check your reactions. It’s time to change your attitude. Dealing with problems won’t be too difficult. Make the most of this opportune day by planning your schedule at work. Hence Ganesha suggests that first focus on finishing all the pending work and then get on to new tasks. Enroll in some physical activity. Health looks good now. Today you would do well to not let your money control you. On the other hand, you should control it and prevent it form spoiling your relations. You might spend liberally on your family to keep them happy. The positive part is that you are very clear about what you want in life. However, the negative part is that you tend to lose your temper quickly today. Your impulsive nature may land you in trouble as you may react to something irrationally and not bother about the consequences.

Matters concerning family bonds will keep you occupied for most part today. Be sure to make all your loved ones feel special. Early in the day, those with whom love’s labour has been lost might try to end all connections. Proceed with caution when it comes to children, advises Ganesha. Make sure tension does not escalate within the family. You may stay away from the minor problems you have been facing in your love life lately. This has become possible only because the two of you have tried your best. You have brought maturity in yourself. You will feel happy if you try to continue with this change. This is not a favorable time to start with new ventures as you maybe confused in your decisions. You’ll be mostly occupied on both professional and personal fronts. But by end of the day, you’ll be able to achieve your target. Health needs attention now, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that your priority today is gong to remain in establishing long-term financial stability so that you can have that most cherished long family vacation abroad. You may be compelled to finish an important project in time. You might remain clueless about what to do and how to do in the morning, but Ganesha feels that luck will help you post lunch and you are likely to achieve the deadline by the evening.

Power is a privilege of a few. It’s a day for those of you in power, of governance and the national purse, says Ganesha. A marvellous day awaits all civil servants and government employees. The dealings you will undertake will materialise and earn you distinction; rewards for the commendable efforts you have put in the past may also come. Professionals, on the other hand, will gain the trust of their bosses and the latter is likely to discuss certain controversial issues with you. You may decide to stay away from the relationships that have been restraining you from being what you are. As a result, you may feel alone tonight but the emotions run deep inside. You will feel concern about your long-term relationship. Ganesha says that it is not a favorable day to get into a conflict as it might make relationships even more strained. You may be high on your emotions. It’s advisable to remain polite to everyone around you. Do not neglect any health issues. Today is a day on which you need to keep your family and friends in good humour because it is them who will come to your aid when you need them, especially on the financial front. Something unusual may happen and disrupt your regular routine today. Unexpected events like travel and meetings are on the cards. You have to be responsible for your team as well as for the workplace. Planning and organising are the important tasks to be done.

A sunny day and a starry night! Today is for friends, says Ganesha. You chat, sing, yell, and even talk philosophy, values and politics with your pals. You may indulge in a romantic evening with your partner, either in a restaurant or at the beach, or simply on the sofa watching Clark Gable woo Scarlet O’ Hara. You may share some interesting things with your loved one. However, Ganesha says it would be good if you don’t bring any professional matters at home. You may tend to be benefit-oriented and simply neglect the matters of the heart. You may spend alone but you should take care of your partner. Ganesha foresees that you’ll be full of energy in the first half of the day. Work life will remain heavy but it wont affect your health. By the second half , you’ll feel more relaxed and reach conclusions. Health looks fine today. All your financial worries may be exaggerated in your mind and can be easily sorted out if only you remained cool and calm. The advise you receive in the evening may come in very handy. You need to be diligent in the workplace today as tasks will keep coming unexpectedly. You should set your priorities as you will be pulled in many directions simultaneously. A new idea may sound weird initially but you will go ahead with it once you calculate its pros and cons.

A turning point in romantic liaisons is likely today, says Ganesha. In love, as at the office, you will discover that there is no substitute for hard work. However, evening promises bountiful pleasure to make up for all the sweat and tears. Your sweetheart will be the right person if you find it difficult to take the right decision in life, says Ganesha. It’s time to discuss the issues related to family and future. You will get the energy and enthusiasm in your love life, feels Ganesha. Tension may begin to build up at the work front, due to which you might even loose your patience. Ganesha advises you to remain calm and composed and try to be polite with everyone around you. Health front may draw your immediate attention. You must avoid borrowing any money today, advises Ganesha, as it could negatively impact your credit rating for a long time. If you wish to purchase something in installments, though, you may go ahead. It is that time in life when you really want to enjoy art, music and other forms of entertainment. You may feel connected to God, enjoying the beauty of nature. The negative part will be the lack of energy and inability to take the correct decisions.
